name: landing-pricing-page
context: Design a pricing tier comparison page for a SaaS or subscription product. The audience is prospective customers evaluating plans, comparing features, and deciding which tier fits their needs. Target platforms: desktop (feature table), tablet, and mobile (stacked cards). The page must make tier differences scannable, highlight the recommended plan, and provide clear upgrade paths.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json scale for plan names, prices, and feature lists
Apply color.rules.json accent tokens to highlight the recommended/popular tier
Layout must adapt from side-by-side comparison on desktop to stacked cards on mobile
Feature comparison table must use proper table semantics (not div grids)
Price display must use typography.display tokens for visual prominence
Toggle for monthly/annual billing must clearly indicate current selection
Comply with Quality_Gate: clear visual hierarchy, no misleading strikethrough pricing without context

outputCriteria.format: Pricing page spec with tier cards, feature comparison matrix, billing toggle, and CTA hierarchy using token references
qualityChecks: Recommended tier is visually distinct via accent surface or border token
Price values use display typography tokens for immediate readability
Feature lists align across tiers for easy horizontal scanning
Billing toggle clearly indicates active state with proper token usage
CTA buttons use action hierarchy (primary for recommended, secondary for others)
accessibilityRequirements: Pricing table uses proper th/td semantics with scope attributes
Billing toggle is an accessible switch with aria-pressed state
Recommended plan indicated programmatically (not just visually)
Feature availability communicated via text (not just checkmark icons)
All tier CTAs have unique accessible names indicating the plan

examples.description: Three-tier pricing layout with billing toggle and highlighted pro plan
examples.output:
Section: PricingSection
  Layout: flex(direction=column, align=center, gap: var(--space-xl))
  padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-lg)
  Children:
    - Atom: Heading(level=h2, token=typography.heading.xl, text='Choose your plan')
    - Molecule: BillingToggle(role=switch, aria-pressed=false)
        labels: ['Monthly', 'Annual (save 20%)']
        track: var(--color-surface-tertiary)
        active: var(--color-action-primary)
    - Organism: TierGrid(grid, columns: repeat(3, 1fr) @desktop | 1fr @mobile, gap: var(--space-lg))
        - Molecule: TierCard(tier='Starter')
            bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
            border: var(--border-default)
            radius: var(--radius-lg)
        - Molecule: TierCard(tier='Pro', recommended=true)
            bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
            border: 2px solid var(--color-action-primary)
            radius: var(--radius-lg)
            - Atom: Badge(text='Most popular', bg=color.action.primary, color=color.text.on-action)
        - Molecule: TierCard(tier='Enterprise')
            bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
            border: var(--border-default)
            radius: var(--radius-lg)
acceptanceCriteria: Recommended tier has distinct border using action.primary token
Badge component marks popular plan for visual and programmatic identification
Grid adapts from 3-column desktop to single-column mobile
Billing toggle uses proper switch role with aria-pressed
